simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גֹּפֶר (H1613) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: גֹּפֶר (gôpher) means a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress First listed occurrence: Gen 6 14.

definitions.short: a kind of tree or wood (as used for building), apparently the cypress
definitions.full: H1613. gopher גֹּ֫פֶר noun [masculine] gopher , only in עֲצֵיגֹּֿפֶר Gen 6:14 (P), wood of which the ark was made (word dubious; Thes compare כֹּפֶר & so Rob Ges (hence ' pitch-wood , resinous wood'), compare Di; Lag Semitica i. 64 ; Symmict. ii. 93, BN 217 ff. thinks word not original, but inferred from גפרית , and substituted here for גפרית by copyist, or editor. compare following).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root, probably meaning to house in;
